name: Pierre-Joseph Desault
summary: French anatomist and distinguished surgeon, first French professor of clinical surgery.

name: Marie François Xavier Bichat
summary: French physiologist and student of Desault who published his works posthumously.

name: François Chopart
summary: French surgeon and pioneer of urology, friend and collaborator of Desault.

name: Marguerite Thouvenin
summary: Wife of Pierre-Joseph Desault.

name: Alexis-Pierre-Mathias
summary: Son of Pierre-Joseph Desault.

name: Louis-Marie Lavergne
summary: Student of Desault who recorded his anatomy lectures in manuscripts.

name: Louis XVI
summary: King of France during Desault's lifetime.

name: Louis XVII
summary: Crown prince of France, son of Louis XVI, treated by Desault.

name: Hôtel-Dieu
summary: Hospital in Paris where Desault worked as chief of surgery.

name: De la Charité
summary: Hospital in Paris where Desault worked as surgeon starting 1782.

name: Military hospital of Belfort
summary: Hospital where Desault acquired knowledge of anatomy and military surgery.

name: Corps of Surgeons
summary: Organization Desault became a member of in 1766.

name: Académie Royale de Chirurgie
summary: Royal Surgical Academy where Desault defended his thesis.

name: Magny-Vernois
summary: Village near Lure where Desault was born.

name: Paris
summary: City where Desault moved in 1764 and worked.

name: Luxembourg
summary: Prison where Desault was detained in 1793.

name: Journal de chirurgerie
summary: Surgical journal established by Desault in 1791.

name: Traitè des maladies chirurgicales
summary: Surgical treatise published by Desault and Chopart in 1779.

name: Oeuvres chirurgicales de Desault
summary: Collection of Desault's surgical doctrines published by Bichat.

name: Desault bandage
summary: Bandage used for binding the elbow to a person's side in fractures of the humerus.
